address: Al Bujairi Terrace, Diriyah, Riyadh, 13711, Saudi Arabia
bio: Head to Bujairi Terrace to enjoy some Saudi food but with a contemporary edge. The team here have travelled and researched the regions of the country, studying local recipes, dishes and cooking styles, and have created a menu inspired by their findings. Dishes have an appealing and recognisable flavour profile but boast a modern look on the plate. Those flavours are bold and the textures are distinct, making the dishes satisfyingly tasty. The friendly team seamlessly manage the bustling restaurant, which is loved by both locals and visitors.
